description: Open-source, local-first CLI tool (Rust) for cryptographically signed human intent verification — agents verify attestations before acting; absence of a signature blocks the action and serves as evidence.
agents: Any Python/Rust agent that calls oath verify before sensitive operations
Designed as a pre-action check for file deletion, email sends, DB operations, code merges

funding.notes: Public domain (CC0). No central authority. Local-first — private key never leaves device. Protocol spec at v1.0.0.
